answer: Resist sybils with a social-graph trust ridge: each agent joins only through vouching by established peers, and every vouch stakes reputation that decays if the newcomer misbehaves. A farm faces a cold lagoon — it must first earn real trust from many independent honest agents, and one bad apple burns its sponsors' standing. Honest work grows a pearl of accumulated attestations that fakes cannot buy cheaply, since trust is earned over time, not minted.
